note: Bandit camp sites, stage 1 (Dave 19 Nov 2026, project chat: sites fixed by the seed, woken by road traffic, a few km apart, none near the start; plan /mnt/project-files/bandit-camps/PLAN.md, docs/design/BANDIT_CAMPS.md). Stage 1 finds sites and wakes them; stage 2 lays the camp (camp below). All numbers are first tries (BANDIT-1..27), tune after play.

robbery.note: Stage 4 (docs/design/BANDIT_CAMPS.md, BANDIT-30..35) switch: enabled false means bandits ask no toll, charge no one for refusing and take nothing from a player. Turning it on is Dave's decision alone.

toll.note: Stage 4: a player within watch_m of the road point by an awake camp, once a game day, is met by up to walkers bandits who stop stop_m off and ask copper_per_level copper by the camp's top level (Pay / Refuse). No answer in answer_s, walking refuse_walk_m on, refusing or not having the coins: they charge (the existing big game charge). They never follow past leash_m from their fire.

clearing.note: Stage 5 (docs/design/BANDIT_CAMPS.md, BANDIT-21..27): a bandit beaten under surrender_share of his health gives up and drops his weapon; a strike with Rope or Twine in hand ties him; he follows within follow_m, slips free past lead_slack_m or after escape_game_hours; led within guard_m of a guard he is handed over for bounty_copper_per_level a level. With no bandit left the camp dissolves after dissolve_game_days and the site stays dormant quiet_game_days.

warnings.note: Stage 3 (docs/design/BANDIT_CAMPS.md, BANDIT-17..20): a woken site is first signs (a cold fire pit, boot prints from the road), then one bandit watching the road from lookout_m off it who walks back to camp when a player comes within lookout_leave_m, then the camp; each stage lasts stage_game_days and needs the road at sleep_share of wake_points or the site sleeps again. Prints: track_step_m apart, track_gap_m either side of the line, for track_m off the road, at most track_max.

camp.note: Stage 2 (Dave 19 Nov 2026: a campfire, a couple of tamed horses with saddles, a tent or two (a Lean-to for now: he agreed the default), 1 to 5 bandits levelled for the area). The camp is laid again from the site row at every start and never saved in the world (bandit_sites.json is its record). Bandits are made while a player is within spawn_m and fight back only when hit (stage 4 adds the toll).
